name: Red Ball vs Green King
storyline:
Our Red ball is angry! They have kidnapped his girlfriend on her own face! "Jajaja" laughs the evil King green ball (bubble green). The King green ball evil wants to steal his girlfriend... "We will not allow it!!"

Red ball hero will have to transform in super Red ball hero to save his fiancee.

Climbing the building exceeding the 50 rooms to save our girl from the King evil green ball king. Along the way are waiting for you hundreds of wicked enemies and thousands of spikes that try to prevent that you get your target.

Defeat the King final boss in one one fight epic, defeat the evil King ball green and save the pink ball in his prison. The King is waiting in final level of the game. win to Green bubble.
summary: A game of "survive-room". Help the red ball save his girlfriend, who has been kidnapped by the green king, as he bounces through 50 levels while avoiding spikes and other obstacles. Players will have to master their control of red ball's speed and constant bouncing pattern in order to reach the end.
